kb_proposals: Porting a lean-gx module into lean-causal: copy, word-bounded rename `GX.` -> `Causal.` (never inside RamcovGX/IsGXAtlas), drop GX.gxPregroupoid/gxGroupoid/exists_smul_eq_of_mem_gxGroupoid in favour of Causal/GXStructure.lean's (identical, except Causal's O-bound is `O ≤ chartSource e ⊓ chartSource e'`); then elaborate the leaf together with `import Causal` in a /tmp file to detect collisions with the whole strict library.

The universal cover, deck group and the classical developing theorem now exist in lean-causal as Causal.UniversalCover / Causal.Deck / Causal.developing_theorem (scaffold/CausalScaffold/Port/): grep there before re-deriving any of them for Barbot's WP-32.
notes:
WP-32a, the port of gx's three graduated modules into lean-causal's scaffold (BARBOT.md, 'The contract with gx'; DEC-33: lean-causal never imports lean-gx). Source: lean-gx at commit e5a1d46 (gx wave 1, WP-24), files GX/Topology/UniversalCover.lean (1181 l.), GX/Structure/Basic.lean (792 l.), GX/Structure/Developing.lean (581 l.). Targets: scaffold/CausalScaffold/Port/UniversalCover.lean (1192 l.), GXBasic.lean (769 l.), Developing.lean (595 l.). All three typecheck with `lake env lean -DwarningAsError=true`: zero errors, zero warnings, no sorry, no axiom; `#print axioms` of the headline theorems (developing_theorem, _fundamentalGroup, developing_unique, developing_descends, developing_theorem_of_simplyConnected, UniversalCover.isCoveringMap_proj, .simplyConnectedSpace, .countable_fundamentalGroup, .deckEquiv, hasGroupoid_iff_isGXAtlas, existsUnique_pullback_of_isCoveringMap, symm_trans_mem_gxGroupoid_iff) is [propext, Classical.choice, Quot.sound]. `lake build CausalScaffold.Port.UniversalCover CausalScaffold.Port.GXBasic` succeeded (1801 jobs, only these two built; Causal.GXStructure was up to date, checked with --no-build first). Developing.lean has NOT been `lake build`-ed (not authorised by the dispatch); it typechecks against the two built oleans.

MECHANICAL CHANGES (all files): `namespace GX`/`end GX` -> `namespace Causal`/`end Causal`; `_root_.GX.x` -> `_root_.Causal.x` (UniversalCover: IsPreconnected.subset_of_pairwise_disjoint, semilocallySimplyConnected_of_isCoveringMap, semilocallySimplyConnected_iff_exists_simplyConnected_cover; Developing: isGXMorphism_of_eventually); qualified `GX.x` -> `Causal.x` in code (UniversalCover: two uses of GX.IsPreconnected.subset_of_pairwise_disjoint; Developing: GX.eq_of_eqOn) and in docstrings; `open GX` -> `open Causal` in two alias docstrings of UniversalCover; imports GX.Structure.Basic / GX.Topology.UniversalCover -> CausalScaffold.Port.GXBasic / CausalScaffold.Port.UniversalCover. The match was word-bounded, so `RamcovGX.tex`, `IsGXAtlas`, `hGX` are untouched.

NON-MECHANICAL CHANGES. (1) GXBasic: `import Causal.GXStructure` added. (2) DEDUP GXBasic: `gxPregroupoid` and `gxGroupoid` not copied; Causal.gxPregroupoid / Causal.gxGroupoid (Causal/GXStructure.lean l.396-423) are used. Checked identical: same explicit binders (G : Type w) (X : Type v) and instance binders [TopologicalSpace X] [Group G] [MulAction G X] [ContinuousConstSMul G X], same `property f s := ∀ x ∈ s, ∃ g : G, f =ᶠ[𝓝 x] fun y => g • y`, same comp/id_mem/locality/congr proofs character for character, gxGroupoid := (gxPregroupoid G X).groupoid in both. Every ported statement and proof mentioning them typechecks unchanged. (3) DEDUP GXBasic: `exists_smul_eq_of_mem_gxGroupoid` not copied (name collision with Causal.exists_smul_eq_of_mem_gxGroupoid, GXStructure.lean l.429). The two differ only in the bound on O: Causal says `O ≤ chartSource e ⊓ chartSource e'`, gx said `(O : Set M) ⊆ e.source ∩ e'.source` (gx's docstring: 'with O : Opens M bounded by e.source ∩ e'.source'); the same set. Its only use in the three files (eventually_smul_eq_of_mem_gxGroupoid) discards that component (`obtain ⟨g, O, hxO, -, hO⟩`), so it typechecks verbatim against the Causal version. gx downstream code that USES the set-form bound will need `fun z hz => hO' hz` or `show`, nothing more, if it ever switches to Causal's lemma. (4) Ported, with no Causal counterpart, now about Causal.gxGroupoid: mem_gxGroupoid_iff, eventually_smul_eq_of_mem_gxGroupoid, symm_trans_mem_gxGroupoid, symm_trans_mem_gxGroupoid_iff. Two `--` comments mark where the deduplicated declarations stood. (5) Docstrings: each gains a port paragraph after its title ('Ported from lean-gx/GX/<path> at commit e5a1d46 (gx wave 1, WP-24), mechanically: namespace GX -> Causal; gxGroupoid deduplicated against Causal.GXStructure' plus the list of non-mechanical changes) and a provenance sentence; in GXBasic the Contents item and provenance sentence that said the groupoid is 'ported from lean-causal ... not imported' are restated as 'imported from Causal/GXStructure.lean', and the section heading '(ported from `lean-causal`)' reads '(from `Causal.GXStructure`)'. No other statement or proof changed in any file.

COLLISIONS. Checked by elaborating Developing.lean (hence all three modules) together with `import Causal` (the whole strict library, up to date) and every built scaffold module (GXSingular, GerochEquiv, MinkowskiMeasure, SingularGeroch, SubExtension, Flat.Form): no duplicate declaration, no ambiguity, no shadowing failure. The only collisions are the three deduplicated names above. Not checked by elaboration: the unbuilt scaffold files Flat/{Achronal,Bieberbach,IsomCausal,Isometries,Penrose} (namespace Causal.Flat; a grep finds none of the ported names declared there). Root-level names: none (every ported declaration is under Causal.*). Global instances introduced: Causal.instSimplyConnectedSpaceUnitInterval (SimplyConnectedSpace I), Causal.isAnalyticAction_translation, Causal.continuousConstSMul_translation (ContinuousConstSMul (Multiplicative ℝ) ℝ; Causal/GXStructure.lean has only a `local instance` of the same Prop, under another name, so no clash), plus TopologicalSpace/PathConnectedSpace/LocPathConnectedSpace instances on UniversalCover and DevSpace.

FOR THE MASTER SESSION. (a) scaffold/CausalScaffold.lean does not import the three Port modules (not my file; kb/0015 item 3: AxiomSweep will not see them until it does). (b) Developing still needs `lake build CausalScaffold.Port.Developing`. (c) The gx lean-gx copies of gxPregroupoid/gxGroupoid/exists_smul_eq_of_mem_gxGroupoid remain GX.*-named; once gx imports Causal it may want to dedup them the same way (GX.exists_smul_eq_of_mem_gxGroupoid has the set-form bound). (d) The docstrings cite `RamcovGX.tex` line numbers of the gx paper and gx package names (WP-24b etc.); no ledger mark (**`label`**) of any prefix is present in the three files, so neither the ETT nor the Barbot ledger reads them. (e) Graduation into Causal/ would be a plain move: the files are warningAsError-clean.
